question: At what times of day can I book or cancel tickets online?
answer: Ticket booking and cancellation hours are 00:20 to 23:45.

question: Money was taken from my account but no ticket was issued. Will I get it back?
answer: Yes. IRCTC refunds the entire fare and its convenience fee to the card/account used, but bank/card transaction charges are likely to be forfeited.

question: What is the flat cancellation charge for a confirmed sleeper class ticket cancelled more than 48 hours before departure?
answer: Rs 120 per passenger.

question: How much is deducted if I cancel a confirmed AC 2 tier ticket 30 hours before the train leaves?
answer: 25% of the fare, subject to the minimum flat charge (Rs 200 + GST for AC 2 tier). Note: the March 2026 PIB release says these windows are revised to 72/24/8 hours.

question: If I don't cancel my confirmed ticket at least 4 hours before departure, can I still get a refund?
answer: No refund is admissible if the confirmed ticket is not cancelled or TDR not filed online up to four hours before scheduled departure.

question: What is the deadline to cancel an RAC e-ticket and still get a refund?
answer: Up to thirty minutes before the scheduled departure of the train.

question: What is the cancellation charge on a Vande Bharat Sleeper ticket cancelled more than 72 hours before departure?
answer: 25% of the fare.

question: Is there any refund if I cancel a Vande Bharat Sleeper ticket 5 hours before departure?
answer: No. Within eight hours of departure no refund is granted.

question: Which refund rules apply to reserved tickets on Amrit Bharat II Express?
answer: The same rules as reserved tickets on Vande Bharat Sleeper Express.

question: From what date did the Vande Bharat Sleeper refund amendment rules come into force?
answer: 16 January 2026.

question: On a family e-ticket some passengers are confirmed and others are waitlisted. Can we get a refund if we all cancel?
answer: Yes: full refund less clerkage, if the ticket is cancelled / TDR filed for all passengers up to thirty minutes before scheduled departure.

question: What happens to a fully waitlisted e-ticket if it is still waitlisted after the chart is prepared?
answer: The passengers' names are dropped from the reservation chart and the fare is refunded to the booking account after deducting clerkage.

question: My train ran more than three hours late and I did not travel. Do I get my money back?
answer: Yes, full fare is refunded with no cancellation charge or clerkage, provided a TDR is filed before the actual departure of the train.

question: My train was cancelled because of a flood. How long do I have to surrender the ticket for a refund?
answer: Within three days, excluding the scheduled day of departure.

question: Where do I post the original GC/EFT certificate for an i-ticket refund?
answer: To the Group General Manager/IT, IRCTC, 2nd Floor, Tower-D, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110029.

question: How long do I have to file a TDR if the train terminated short of my destination?
answer: Up to seventy-two hours of the scheduled arrival of the train at the passenger's destination.

question: I missed my connecting train because the first train was late. How do I claim a refund?
answer: The PNRs should be linked and a TDR filed within three hours of the actual arrival of the train the passenger travelled on.

question: Can I cancel a counter (i-ticket) booking online?
answer: No, i-tickets cannot be cancelled online.

question: From when can Tatkal tickets on IRCTC be booked only by Aadhaar authenticated users?
answer: From 1 July 2025.

question: When did Aadhaar OTP authentication become compulsory for Tatkal booking?
answer: From 15 July 2025.

question: Can an authorised agent book an opening-day Tatkal ticket for an AC class at 10:15?
answer: No. Agents cannot book opening-day Tatkal tickets from 10:00 to 10:30 for AC classes (11:00 to 11:30 for non-AC).

question: What is the advance reservation period now and from when does it apply?
answer: 60 days (excluding the date of journey), with effect from 01.11.2024; it was 120 days before.

question: I booked a ticket 100 days in advance on 25 October 2024. Is my booking still valid?
answer: Yes. All bookings made up to 31.10.2024 under the 120-day ARP remain intact.

question: What is the advance booking limit for foreign tourists?
answer: 365 days; it was not changed.

question: How far in advance is the first reservation chart prepared for a train departing at 18:00?
answer: Preferably 8 hours in advance (trains departing between 14:00 and 05:00).

question: Which commercial circular changed the timing of the first reservation chart?
answer: Commercial Circular No. 10 of 2025, dated 02.07.2025.

question: Can I change my boarding station after the chart has been prepared?
answer: Yes, under the new reform passengers can change their boarding station digitally up to 30 minutes before the train leaves its origin station.

question: What new cancellation time windows did the Railways announce in March 2026?
answer: The earlier windows of 48, 12 and 4 hours before departure were revised to 72, 24 and 8 hours.

question: What was the clerkage for unreserved second class tickets before the 2015 revision, and what is it after?
answer: Rs 15 before the revision, Rs 30 after (w.e.f. 12.11.2015).

question: Do I need to file a TDR to get a refund on an e-ticket when the train is cancelled?
answer: No. Since 01.07.2015 the refund is automatic; no TDR is required.

question: Which Railway Board letter is the authority for the IRCTC refund rules?
answer: Railway Board letter No. TCII/2003/2015/Refund Policy/1 dated 06-Nov-2015.

question: What is the reference number of Commercial Circular No. 10 of 2024?
answer: No. 2007/TG-I/20/P/ARP/e-file, dated 16.10.2024.

question: Will my waitlisted ticket WL 25 on the Rajdhani get confirmed?
answer: I don't know. Whether a waitlisted ticket will confirm cannot be known from the pack.

question: What is the fare of a sleeper ticket from Delhi to Mumbai?
answer: I don't know. The pack has no fare tables.

question: What is the live running status of train 12951 right now?
answer: I don't know. The pack has no live train status.

question: Can I carry my pet dog on the train?
answer: I don't know. The documents don't cover pets.

question: What is the status of PNR 4512345678?
answer: I don't know. The pack has no PNR data.
